message: 天使は何語で喋るのか？

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san isn't here...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's weird. Normally, she'd be sitting right around here looking all imposing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could she have gone to the restroom or something?」

name: Misa
message: 「Even so, she's taking way too long.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll say this to protect Melilot's dignity. That girl is in the toilet--」

name: Melilot
message: 「I wasn't doing anything of the sort, nor was I in the restroom.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, welcome back♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「You must not take Helena's words at face value. Everything she says is completely groundless.」

name: Helena
message: 「I hadn't even said anything yet~」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you know the story of the boy who cried wolf? When it really matters, nobody's gonna believe you!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh dear, I'm getting lectured by my little sister.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! I might be your little sister, but in front of everyone, I'm a proper upperclassman!」

name: Helena
message: 「Grrr, only your boobs got proper! Outrageous! Simply outrageous!」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, aahn! Stop it!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... so, what were you doing, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「A problem arose, so I was investigating the cause.」

name: Synn
message: 「A problem...!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「We have been destroying the magic circle since last night, but that did not go well.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then does that mean Re-Crea can still be exploited?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please do not panic. Even if there is a problem, we simply need to resolve it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So that's why you were looking into it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. It seems that in addition to magical power, the magic circle has been tampered with using Spirit Power to prevent its destruction.」

name: Misa
message: 「If it's spiritual power, then one of the angels must have...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-It wasn't me, okay!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nobody said anything yet.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Furthermore, it is Spirit Power of the utmost purity, making it impossible to read even a summary of its structure.」

name: Helena
message: 「So even if we want to unlock it, we can't do anything if we can't even see the keyhole.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Which brings us to the matter at hand. I would like to borrow your power, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really do suspect me after all~~!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is not the case, Lolotte. Only an angel can undo this.」

name: Melilot
message: 「How does it look...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm~~. I can see something faint and blurry, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you able to translate that into a language?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry... Maybe because I played too many video games at the President's house, it seems my eyesight has gotten worse.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's my fault!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Lolotte, how long has it been since you came to the Human World?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be about a year soon, I think.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your spiritual essence is turning into physical matter. It appears you are gradually becoming closer to a human.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that true!?」

name: Ria
message: 「At this rate, Lolotte-chan won't be an angel anymore...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I don't really mind.」

name: Ria
message: 「Just like that!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being in the Human World is more fun, so it's fine. Besides, Amyrina is also--」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, it seems I'm getting a call. Excuse me for a moment.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could Spirit Power be infused in it because Soltia was the one who created this magic circle?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She is merely a demon close to the angels; she could not perform a feat of this caliber.」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, it would mean another angel is involved.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia, Bylous... and aside from the wildcard, Azel-san, someone else is lending a hand to this plan...」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot. Isn't there a chance Azel-chan is an angel?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. So that is why Helena permitted Azel-san's transfer without a single doubt.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey now. You're giving me too much credit. Even I couldn't tell on the very day we met.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, you dimly sensed that she was no ordinary person, didn't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis... why don't you ever tell me important things like that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because I didn't have solid proof... If weird rumors started spreading, it'd be awful for Azel-chan, wouldn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why did you approve Azel's enrollment?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because she's cute, of course.」
Whether she was lying or telling the truth, either way, Helena-san was the last person I ever wanted to make an enemy of.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, it's not set in stone yet that Azel is an angel, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. Looking at the expression on Lolotte-san's face--being an angel herself--gives a pretty clear idea.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is Azel... an angel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, I never met Azel-san in Heaven. We first got to know each other in the Human World.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We promised each other to keep the fact that we're angels a secret...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just what do an angel and a demon intend to do with Re-Crea by working together...」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. Because in the exact same way, angels, demons... and humans will join hands to stop it.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the Demon Lord's-no. That's our duty as the Crusaders, isn't it, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「...Yeah!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If only we could at least destroy the magic circle...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry I couldn't be of any help...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, no. You didn't do anything wrong at all, Lolotte-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san...」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, video games are limited to one hour a day, okay?\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauuu~」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister~~!! Lolotte-dono~~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Shio-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「Over here, Shio!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Was that phone call earlier from Shio-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Apparently, there's someone looking for Lolotte-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looking for Lolotte?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my, forgive my rudeness. I had not the slightest inkling she was a friend of Lolotte-dono.」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you do?」

name: Shio
message: 「Merely a touch of intimidation.」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez! Stop charging at anyone and everyone without thinking!」

name: Shio
message: 「Forgive my insolence!!」

name: Synn
message: 「--So, Amyrina got lost at school.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes... Just once, I wanted to see what this 'school' place Lolotte talked about was like...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's trespassing, Amyrina. If the ruler of the academy, the Chairwoman, were to ever catch you, it'd be a total disaster.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My, my. What a coincidence, Chairwoman.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「H-Heeeeek!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Could it be that you're...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A-Am I going to be judged in the name of the law...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Nope. You're cute, so I'll let it slide♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「R-Really? Phew...」
So approving Azel's transfer really was just a knee-jerk reaction after all.

name: Ria
message: 「Amyrina... are you Lolotte's friend?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Believe it or not, we are actually childhood friends!」

name: Ria
message: 「...Which means you're an angel too, right!?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hawawah!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Amyrina. Would you mind lending us a bit of your cooperation?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! If it's Amyrina, she might be able to read it!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「This cannot be expressed in modern language. Would writing out the characters suffice?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That will be fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't read a single word of what's written here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「These are the exact same characters written in the guidebook.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, really? That's amazing, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though I haven't the slightest clue what they mean.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you very much. With this--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Prad Kcev Qutioxe. Topue Stachz Duemnskia.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Teaox.」
Our surroundings were enveloped in a dazzling light.
Despite being light, the air was filled with a cold, oppressive heaviness.
Swirling like a vortex, it soon faded away.
With a tome in one hand, Melilot-san let out a deep breath.

name: Melilot
message: 「It has been proven. The seal placed on this magic circle is the work of an angel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Assuming it wasn't either of the angels who appeared in Ryuusei Town... neither Lolotte-san nor Amyrina-san--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then it is indeed highly likely that Azel-san is the one who cast this seal.」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, we really can't just leave Azel alone!」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's all go look for her after all!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. Please leave Azel-san to me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I want you all to focus solely on Bylous, and on making the Holy Night Festival a success.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you don't, the time will come while all of our goals are left half-finished.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Assuming she is an angel, she will likely make her move on her own.」

name: Melilot
message: 「She descended to the Human World despite taking on various risks, all to fulfill a certain purpose.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have a rough idea of Azel-san's whereabouts. However, if I were to tell Sakura-kun and the others where she is...」

name: Melilot
message: 「They would surely head there to save her. However, in the event that Azel-san is an enemy--」

name: Melilot
message: 「As an angel... that resolve of hers, to cast aside even the pride of her race to bring about Re-Crea alongside the demons.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I can only assume she is bearing the weight of something immense. The chances of her listening to Sakura-kun and the others' persuasion are low.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Therefore, I alone am enough to dirty my hands with this. Someone like me, who lives in the shadows, is enough to be despised.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm sorry... Perhaps I've avoided the light for so long that my heart has become twisted.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't make such a worried face. It will be alright. I will definitely save Azel-san, I promise.」
